item.title: Overview of Habakkuk - The Righteous Shall Live by Faith 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # Leah had always been the quiet centre of her family’s gravity. She wasn’t dramatic or loud, and she didn’t demand attention. Her strength was quieter, the kind that shows up every morning before sunrise, when the house is still dark, and the world feels fragile. She would pad softly into the kitchen, brew her coffee, open her Bible, and pray with a steady persistence that had carried her through decades of life.
